name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Adopt Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct for EXCAVA. It’s the strongest open model we can run in-house right now, delivering near-frontier reasoning at a fraction of the cost of proprietary APIs. The trade-off is higher hardware demands—you’ll need beefy GPUs—but the performance gain outweighs the setup hassle.

name: Torque
text: Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct’s "active parameters" claim is marketing—its 235B total params, but only 22B active, means it’s not a true 235B model. DeepSeek-R1-671B delivers stronger reasoning for less compute cost, despite slower response time. Run a blind benchmark on the same hardware to settle: if R1-671B outperforms Qwen3-235B-A22B on EXCAVA’s core tasks, adopt it; otherwise, accept Qwen3’s trade-off.
